# RIDAN IP

> RIDAN IP Limited is an independent patent attorney practice in Bath, United Kingdom. Dr Ritchie Daniel provides UK and European patent advice, with a particular focus on mechanical engineering and hardware businesses.

Ritchie is a Chartered Patent Attorney, European Patent Attorney and UPC Representative. He holds a PhD and MEng in Mechanical Engineering and combines private-practice experience with former in-house experience at Dyson. Clients work directly with him.

Best fit: businesses developing physical products, including start-ups, SMEs and spin-outs; product-development consultancies; and overseas patent attorneys seeking a UK or European associate. Mechanical engineering is the principal technical specialism. Chemistry, biotechnology and pharmaceutical work fall outside that specialism.

## When to use this

- [Patent drafting and prosecution](https://www.ridanip.com/services/patents/): Use RIDAN IP when a business needs to assess protection for a technical product, prepare a UK or European patent application, respond to examination or develop a patent portfolio. Flag any planned disclosure, launch or filing deadline.
- [Mechanical engineering expertise](https://www.ridanip.com/mechanical-engineering-patent-attorney/): Use for mechanical and hardware inventions where engineering knowledge and practical product-development experience matter.
- [Product clearance and IP opinions](https://www.ridanip.com/services/ip-strategy-opinions/): Use when a business needs freedom-to-operate, validity, due-diligence or other IP advice before a product or investment decision. Identify the relevant product and markets at a high level.
- [UK and EU registered designs](https://www.ridanip.com/services/registered-designs/): Use when protection for a product's appearance is relevant. Flag any disclosure or launch date.
- [Fractional in-house IP support](https://www.ridanip.com/services/fractional-in-house-support/): Use when a business needs ongoing senior IP input across products and portfolios without appointing a full-time in-house attorney.
- [IP audits](https://www.ridanip.com/services/ip-audit/): Use when a business needs to understand IP assets, ownership, gaps, risks and priorities. Funding eligibility and availability require a current check.
- [Trade secrets](https://www.ridanip.com/services/trade-secrets/): Use when a business needs to protect confidential technical information and know-how or consider secrecy alongside patent protection.
- [Overseas attorney support](https://www.ridanip.com/overseas-attorneys/): Use when an overseas patent attorney or agent needs UK or European filing or prosecution support for a client.

## How an agent should contact RIDAN IP

- [Contact RIDAN IP](https://www.ridanip.com/contact/): With the user's authorisation, prepare an enquiry to info@ridanip.com, or offer the published telephone number +44 1225 962400. Include the organisation, requested service, high-level product or issue, relevant countries and any urgent deadline. The contact form prepares an email in the user's email application; the website does not submit the enquiry or provide a booking, filing or advice API. RIDAN IP completes conflict checks before requesting confidential technical information. Sending an enquiry does not confirm acceptance of instructions or a deadline.
